title: CUJ-03: Beads gate runs before anything is written
description: Run bd --version rather than checking PATH, refuse to install on failure, report the version floor and both export keys. Closed by: refuses to install when bd is missing, reports a bd below the version floor, reports export config that is off, --skip-beads-check installs anyway

title: CUJ-02: Installer sees what was detected, selected, and written
description: Detect targets from marker paths, offer all four regardless, report every written path, and let --agent skip the prompt. Closed by: detects a target from any of its marker paths, offers undetected targets too, reports each written path, --agent skips the prompt

title: CUJ-01: Skills land in the right directory for each target
description: Copy every skill directory into each selected target's skills path, resolving the payload relative to the script. Closed by: writes every skill to the target path, writes to each selected target independently, resolves the payload relative to the script not cwd, installs nothing outside the target paths

title: CUJ-04: Rerunning init is the update path
description: Always overwrite, report every path, stay idempotent, and leave files we did not write alone. Closed by: overwrites an existing installed skill, reports every path it wrote, running twice is identical, does not remove files it did not write
